label: 1 iff an input-view first laser hit (2x ray density) lies in the cell; all other cells 0
grid: input-visible laser hit bounding box + 1 cell margin; fixed metric cell
probe_inputs: frozen TokenGS image features (PCA) at 9 points/cell + camera/cell geometry; no laser, SfM, Gaussians or box-relative coordinates

scopes.near_surface: within 2 cells (Chebyshev) of a positive cell

training: 1/2 positives, 1/4 uniform negatives, 1/4 near-surface negatives per batch

test_label_oracle_in_frustum_diagnostic.warning: thresholds chosen with VALIDATION labels; ranking diagnostic only, not deployable
